This '''woman''' was married to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tharil Tavira]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of [[Eiattu 6]], at some point during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial era]]. Tavira's mistress, [[Leonia Tavira]], arranged her "accidental" [[Death/Legends|death]], and married the Moff herself.<ref name="AGttSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref>
